summary: HEICO Corporation filed an 8-K reporting a fourth amendment to its revolving credit agreement. The amendment increases the credit facility capacity from $2.0 billion to $2.2 billion, extends the maturity to June 11, 2031, adjusts the applicable rate based on senior unsecured long-term debt ratings, and releases subsidiary guarantees. This is a routine debt facility amendment, not a special situation. The filing represents ordinary financing activity without any acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change. No special situation category applies.
